verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents programmatic instance lifecycle control through its CLI, REST API and Python SDK, including an explicit `vast.start_instance(id=...)` call and a CLI walkthrough that ends with cleanup. Instances bill by the second for actual usage, which supports paying only for what runs. missing for 10: explicit documented stop/restart/destroy commands or endpoints, clarity on whether stopped instances still incur storage charges, independent hands-on corroboration of lifecycle automation.
